story.title: A year of fighting scrapers on my 1.5 million-page website

draft:
I just spent a year battling scrapers on my 1.5 million-page website. 
I've learned that 99% of my traffic is bots, overwhelming my servers. 
Key takeaways include using IP blocking and rate limiting to mitigate damage. 
What strategies do you use to fight web scraping on your site?
#webscraping #botmanagement #cybersecurity
